how_it_works.title: How ModularAI Works
how_it_works.step1_desc: We identify one measurable decision or business problem worth solving.
how_it_works.step2_desc: We review the relevant systems, available data, quality and access requirements.
how_it_works.step3_desc: We connect the required data and build a focused analysis, dashboard or decision-support workflow.
how_it_works.step4_desc: If the pilot creates value, we automate, integrate and extend the solution where justified.
how_it_works.trust_desc: ModularAI works alongside your existing infrastructure. Data access, integrations and deployment are defined according to the requirements of each project.
how_it_works.trust_bullet3: Only the data required for the agreed purpose
how_it_works.trust_bullet4: Private or controlled deployment options where required
